title: JAD OC's
description: JAD MOD: Master survival with my OCs! Explore new dimensions, use powerful potions, and freeze time with a single click. The classic adventure is back!
body:
JAD MOD: The Ultimate Crossover
JAD MOD is a massive survival expansion that brings my original furry characters (OCs) into the Minecraft universe. This mod is crafted for players seeking a hardcore experience, blending inter-dimensional lore with unique gameplay mechanics.

✨ Key Features
The Interstellar Arrival: Explore the Spacecraft my OCs used to travel to this world. This ship is designed with extreme power and high resistance to withstand the pressure of inter-universal travel.

One-Click Time Control: Forget about typing /freeze or /unfreeze commands! This mod adds a specialized Stopwatch that allows you to freeze the entire game with a single click.

The Classic Return: Witness the return of the Classic Minecraft Overworld, reimagined for a new era of exploration.

New Dimensions & Realms: Journey through mysterious dimensions featuring unique biomes and dangerous threats.

Survival Overhaul: Survival is no longer easy. Master new, complex crafting recipes and discover advanced alchemy to brew powerful potions necessary for your journey.

⚠️ Warning: Hardcore Experience
This mod is designed to be challenging. You will need to manage your resources carefully and master the new crafting systems to survive the collision of these universes.

🛠️ Technical Specs
Version: 1.21.4

Loader: NeoForge

Java: Requires Java 21

¿Qué sigue ahora?
Una vez que pegues esto, solo te queda esperar a que los moderadores revisen el archivo (el estado "Baking" pasará a ser "Approved").
